sourceText:
Bacon Cheese Souffle
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, December 31, 2009 - 11:38pm

Ingredients




1/4 cup butter
3 tablespoons flour
1 1/4 cups light cream
1/2 cup bacon, cooked and crumbled
5 egg yolks, lightly beaten
1 tablespoon dry minced onion flakes
1/4 teaspoon seasoned pepper
5 egg whites
1/4 teaspoon seasoned salt
1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar
1 cup Cheddar cheese, grated

Preparation

1 In medium saucepan, melt butter, stir in flour and continue cooking until bubbly. Gradually add cream, stirring constantly until mixture thickens. Add bacon and beat in egg yolks, add dry onion flakes and seasoning pepper. Pour mixture into large bowl and set aside. 2 Beat egg whites, seasoned salt and cream of tartar until very stiff but not dry. Fold in grated cheese. Fold egg whites/cheese mixture into yolk mixture. Spoon into ungreased 1 1/2 quart souffle dish with collar. 3 Set souffle dish in glass dish filled 1 inch deep with hot water. Bake in 375 degree oven for about 30 minutes or until souffle is puffy and golden brown. Serve immediately. Serves 6.
